projects.title: Feature placement for AI solution

projects.problem: RMs serving high-net-worth and senior clients lose hours to routine requests, which caps how many clients they can serve well.

projects.title: Designing reusable datatable
projects.small-description: Designed and developed one of the most complex custom reusable lightning-datatable allowing developers to use images/tags/buttons inline, leading to project expanding to other lines of businesses
projects.problem: Client required a highly-functional layout with a table displaying information consolidated from 6 different SF objects and 10+ fields meeting criteria. SF out-of-the-box datatable didn't allow this.
projects.key decision: I designed a custon datatypes data table component that could be used across differnt features throughout the project ensuring the right level of flexibility and maintainability.
projects.impact: Project was identified as a value maximizing project and was expanded to other lines of businesses.

projects.key decision: Designed a Google Workspace Flow which automatically checks emails for deadlines and creates google calendar events to track effectively.

projects.title: Pay for what you eat
projects.small-description: Created a prototype for a College Mess Management
projects.problem: Students had to pay for mess food even if they didn't eat, leading to food wastage and paying for more.
projects.key decision: Created a prototype for a College Mess Management portal where students only pay for what they want to eat. Mess management analyzes students' attendance data over time and plan better.
